Chapter 925: Chapter 22: For Thousands Of Years (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 925: Chapter 22: For Thousands of Years (Please Subscribe)

“Is the Immortal Realm consciousness enraged?”

The tremors in the Primordial Lands were sensed by the Ancestor of the Immortal Path immediately.

“Is it the Ancestor of Martial Arts drawing near to the Immortal Realm consciousness?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path looked toward the very center of the Primordial Lands and felt no surprise.

Although he had long warned Lin Yuan that the consciousness of the Immortal Realm is terrifying and could easily mobilize the power of the entire Immortal Realm,

the place where the Immortal Realm consciousness resides contains all the rules of the Immortal Realm, a temptation far too great, which is why he had once approached the Immortal Realm consciousness himself.

And as a result, he had suffered quite a setback.

Now that Lin Yuan is approaching the consciousness of the Immortal Realm, he must have discovered this as well.

“Let’s see how long the Ancestor of Martial Arts can withstand the Immortal Realm consciousness,” the Ancestor of the Immortal Path wondered with slight curiosity.

Even if one is an Ancestral Immortal, they cannot directly confront the entire Immortal Realm; it’s all about how long they can resist.

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path was ready to assist, once he saw that Lin Yuan might not be able to withstand it any longer.

Having experienced a confrontation with the Immortal Realm consciousness, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path was confident he could retreat with Lin Yuan unharmed, thereby gaining a favor from the Ancestor of Martial Arts.

“Right now, the Immortal Realm consciousness is merely mobilizing the power of the Primordial Lands, which is still normal, but once it mobilizes the power of the entire Immortal Realm, that will be truly fearsome.”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path focused closely, rapidly pondering in his mind.

…

Whoosh.

A terrifying force swept over, enveloping Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan did not attempt to resist at all, knowing that in terms of the hierarchy of power, he was even inferior to the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, let alone the Immortal Realm consciousness.

The biggest reliance Lin Yuan dared to draw close was his comprehension of the rules, specifically his comprehension of time-space.

The Seventh Realm comprehension of time-space allowed Lin Yuan to reign over the Immortal Realm on the temporal and spatial plane, which was also why the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss’s attempt to break through a certain region’s time-space couldn’t affect Lin Yuan.

Boom.

The furious force from the Origin Power, in an instant, swept past Lin Yuan, then charged into the distance.

“It didn’t touch me?”

Lin Yuan felt certain in his heart.

As long as the Immortal Realm consciousness couldn’t touch him, everything would be manageable.

If the Immortal Realm consciousness could lock onto the location of Lin Yuan’s true body, then he would definitely no longer approach.

Boom.

Without touching Lin Yuan, the Immortal Realm consciousness didn’t stop, instead it continued to gather the power of the entire Primordial Lands to suppress him.

Lin Yuan did not interfere, but continued to slowly approach the location where the Immortal Realm consciousness resided.

Several days passed quickly.

Perhaps realizing that it couldn’t touch Lin Yuan, after a brief pause, a wave of consciousness emerged, indicating that the Immortal Realm consciousness wanted to communicate with Lin Yuan.

The Immortal Realm consciousness, being a consciousness, could certainly communicate. It just never needed to against the Ancestor of the Immortal Path previously.

But now, Lin Yuan’s presence made the Immortal Realm consciousness feel ‘troubled,’ to at least no end, which is why it initiated communication.

“Let me in, to experience the rules themselves,” Lin Yuan communicated his purpose as well.

“Impossible,” the Immortal Realm consciousness responded furiously, outright refusing.

Its location was at the core of the Primordial Lands, the very source where the consciousness of the Immortal Realm was born.

It’s not just the source of the myriad rules of the Immortal Realm but also the foundation of its own consciousness.

If Lin Yuan were to enter, what he could do would not be limited to perceiving the rules themselves but also laying hands directly on the Immortal Realm consciousness.

Outside the core area, the Immortal Realm consciousness could easily mobilize the power of the entire realm, omnipresent, but within the core, the power of the Immortal Realm couldn’t penetrate.

Even the force of the Origin Power couldn’t affect it; in the core, the Immortal Realm consciousness was like a toothless tiger.

“I promise I won’t lay a hand on you,” Lin Yuan immediately stated.

Having once replaced the world consciousness of the Tianqing World, he knew exactly what these consciousnesses feared most, so he quickly gave his assurance.

However, the Immortal Realm consciousness did not respond to him, it even quieted down the boiling Primordial Lands swiftly.

“Not willing to communicate with me?” Lin Yuan thought for a moment and continued to approach the core where the Immortal Realm consciousness resided.

Very soon.

Lin Yuan stopped.

“A time-space barrier?”

Lin Yuan gazed at the distorted space-time before him.

Even with his Seventh Realm time-space comprehension, he couldn’t advance any further at this moment.

“It seems this is your reliance?” Lin Yuan had a sense of it in his mind.

To enter the core where the Immortal Realm consciousness resided, besides facing the frenzied counterattack from the Immortal Realm consciousness, one must also cross the time-space barrier before them.

“Divine Skills… Rend the Heavens.”

Lin Yuan raised his right hand, and an invisible force converged, gently tearing at the time-space barrier in front of him.

This Divine Skill was awakened during Lin Yuan’s recent traversal, a Physical Body Divine Ability, either pure or extremely offensive.

Rip.

With one tear from Lin Yuan, the time-space barrier before him began to ripple slightly, but in an instant, it recovered.

“Did it work?” Lin Yuan did not continue his action.

A moment later.

Two figures appeared not too far away.

It was Lin Yuan’s Taiyin Primordial Spirit and Taiyang Divine Spirit.

The power of the Divine Skill Rend the Heavens depended on the comprehensive foundation of the user.

Avatars conjured by Lin Yuan, although possessing high combat prowess, were obviously far inferior to his two major Primordial Spirits.

Of course, even the two major Primordial Spirits had a vast gap compared to the true body.

The ‘Rend the Heavens’ Divine Skill deployed by the avatars could only slightly stir ripples on the time-space barrier.

But the two Primordial Spirits…

Rip.

The two Primordial Spirits extended their right hands, gently tearing at the distant space-time barrier.

In an instant, the space-time barrier began to tremble slightly, before quickly returning to normal.

“If you don’t let me in now, I will bring the Ancestor of the Immortal Path with me,” Lin Yuan actively communicated with the consciousness of the Immortal Realm. “With the Ancestor of the Immortal Path’s attack capabilities, even if he cannot break the space-time barrier in a short time, given enough time— one hundred million years, one billion years, ten billion years—will you be able to stop him?”

In fact, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path’s methods could not reach the space-time barrier at all; before getting close, he was suppressed by the overwhelming power of the world summoned by the consciousness of the Immortal Realm.

But the situation would be different with Lin Yuan’s help.

The insights Lin Yuan gained in the Seventh Realm of space-time made him untraceable even by the consciousness of the Immortal Realm.

If Lin Yuan truly intended to bring the Ancestor of the Immortal Path over, what he had just mentioned could truly be realized.

Of course, Lin Yuan was only making a threat; in reality, he could not wait for a hundred million or ten billion years either.

But the consciousness of the Immortal Realm didn’t know that.

“By that time, I can’t guarantee I won’t take action against you,” Lin Yuan continued.

The consciousness of the Immortal Realm still gave no response.

“In that case, I will go and bring over the Ancestor of the Immortal Path now, and while I’m at it, I’ll also fetch the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.” One of Lin Yuan’s avatars dissolved into silence.

At that moment.

The previously silent consciousness of the Immortal Realm began to stir once again, sending a message to Lin Yuan.

The gist of it was.

How could Lin Yuan assure that once he enters the core area, he won’t take action against the consciousness of the Immortal Realm?

“You don’t have the right to negotiate with me,” Lin Yuan shook his head. “Either you agree and let me in now, or a hundred billion years later, I and the Ancestor of the Immortal Path will force our way in.”

Having said this, Lin Yuan quietly waited for the reply from the consciousness of the Immortal Realm.

After a long time.

The consciousness of the Immortal Realm finally sent another message.

It agreed to Lin Yuan’s demands.

To Lin Yuan, a hundred million or a billion years was an incredibly long time.

But for the consciousness of the Immortal Realm, it was almost the same as tomorrow or the day after.

So the problem now facing the consciousness of the Immortal Realm was simple.

Let Lin Yuan in today.

Or be forced by Lin Yuan tomorrow or the day after.

The two outcomes were drastically different.

“That’s more like it,” Lin Yuan smiled slightly.

The two Primordial Spirits disappeared, leaving only one avatar standing there.

The distant space-time barrier began to distort, forming a temporary passageway to the core area.

The next moment.

Lin Yuan stepped into it.

…

“Hm?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path’s eyes widened.

As soon as the Primordial Lands began to tremble, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path had been observing the contest between Lin Yuan and the consciousness of the Immortal Realm through some method.

Seeing Lin Yuan, who is profound in the martial arts of space-time approaching the core area, only to be stopped outside the space-time barrier, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path was watching all along.

Afterward, when Lin Yuan’s two Primordial Spirits appeared and executed a heaven-tearing strike, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path was also aware.

Although the Ancestor of the Immortal Path did not know the exact content of the communication between Lin Yuan and the consciousness of the Immortal Realm, the final act of the consciousness of the Immortal Realm in voluntarily opening up a passageway allowing Lin Yuan to enter was crystal clear in the eyes of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

“Did the Ancestor of Martial Arts go in?”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path was slightly stunned. For countless eons, he had also been longing to enter the core place where the consciousness of the Immortal Realm resided, but it was merely a longing; unless he could once again achieve a qualitatively substantial leap in strength.

Otherwise, he was no match for the consciousness of the Immortal Realm at all.

But Lin Yuan?

Having just arrived in the Primordial Lands for a mere two hundred years, yet entering a place even the Ancestor of the Immortal Path had long desired but could not reach?

…

At the core of the Primordial Lands.

Lin Yuan appeared here.

All around him, darkness reigned, with countless points of light drifting slowly.

At a glance, Lin Yuan realized that these points of light corresponded to certain rules themselves.

In the pitch-black space, countless points of light were floating, with the smallest being the size of a fist and the largest as vast as stars.

“This is marvelous.”

Lin Yuan observed each point of light, even the smallest of which contained countless pieces of information; they represented the rules themselves. Even though Lin Yuan had already thoroughly comprehended these rules, a fresh observation was still immensely valuable.

“As the Immortal Path enters its end times, these core points of light will collapse one by one, corresponding to the collapse of the Great Dao in the outer world.”

“After the collapse of all the rules contained in these points of light, will they vaguely merge together, waiting for rebirth after a long period of destruction?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. Upon entering the core area, he had immediately fallen into an enlightened state, with rules being comprehended and understood in every moment.

“Hm?”

“Is that the actual body of the consciousness of the Immortal Realm?”

Lin Yuan glanced over with the remaining focus of his mind and spotted a glowing orb floating in the distance.

This orb was different from the other points of light around it, and it was the consciousness of the Immortal Realm.

At this moment, the orb was watching Lin Yuan with extreme wariness.

The concerns of the consciousness of the Immortal Realm were clear to Lin Yuan, who at this moment couldn’t be bothered to reassure it, completely immersing his mind in the endless points of light around him.

Time passed.

Unknowingly, a thousand years had gone by.
